statements.label: supported
statements.text: Across more than two decades of field records, tan and white sparrows mated almost exclusively with partners of the opposite morph.
statements.evidence: Using over two decades of field data, we document near-perfect disassortative mating among morphs
statements.note: Over two decades of field data documented near-perfect disassortative mating, meaning each morph nearly always paired with the other morph.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: White-morph sparrows are more aggressive in defending their territories than tan-morph sparrows.
statements.evidence: This species comprises two morphs, tan and white, that differ in pigmentation and components of social behavior [3-5].
statements.note: The abstract says the two morphs differ in components of social behavior but never states which morph is more aggressive or in what direction they differ.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Genetic diversity in the tan supergene allele is surprisingly low, although several canonical signs of repeated positive selection are absent from it.
statements.evidence: the "tan" allele has surprisingly low levels of genetic diversity yet does not show several canonical signatures of recurrent positive selection
statements.note: The abstract reports surprisingly low genetic diversity in the tan allele together with an absence of several canonical signatures of recurrent positive selection.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: More than 1,000 genes are highly divergent between the two alternative alleles of the sparrow's inversion-based supergene.
statements.evidence: alternate supergene alleles are highly divergent at over 1,000 genes
statements.note: De novo genome sequencing combined with population and phylogenomic data showed the alternate supergene alleles are highly divergent at over 1,000 genes.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Depending on which species and conserved genes are used, the phylogeny places the eukaryote ancestor either inside Asgard or on a deeper branch within archaea.
statements.evidence: depending on the choice of species and conserved genes used to build the phylogeny-supports either the origin of eukaryotes from within Asgard (as a sister group to the expanded Heimdallarchaeota-Wukongarchaeota branch) or a deeper branch for the eukaryote ancestor within archaea
statements.note: The phylogenomic analysis did not resolve the relationship unequivocally, supporting either an origin within Asgard or a deeper archaeal branch depending on species and gene choice.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Protein domain analysis of the 162 Asgard genomes substantially enlarged the known set of eukaryotic signature proteins.
statements.evidence: Our comprehensive protein domain analysis using the 162 Asgard genomes results in a major expansion of the set of eukaryotic signature proteins
statements.note: The domain analysis across 162 Asgard genomes produced a major expansion of the set of eukaryotic signature proteins.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The analysis led to six additional Asgard phyla being proposed, including a deeply branching lineage provisionally named Wukongarchaeota.
statements.evidence: lead us to propose six additional phyla that include a deep branch that we have provisionally named Wukongarchaeota
statements.note: The abstract states that the results expand Asgard diversity and lead to the proposal of six additional phyla, including the deep branch Wukongarchaeota.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The eukaryotic signature proteins encoded by Asgard archaea carry out the same cellular functions as their counterparts in eukaryotic cells.
statements.evidence: The Asgard eukaryotic signature proteins show variable phyletic distributions and domain architectures, which is suggestive of dynamic evolution through horizontal gene transfer, gene loss, gene duplication and domain shuffling.
statements.note: The abstract describes the phyletic distributions and domain architectures of these proteins but reports nothing about their cellular functions.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The noncoding elements accelerated in flightless paleognaths also show accelerated evolution in flightless birds outside the paleognaths, such as rails.
statements.evidence: identified 2355 independent accelerations along lineages of flightless paleognaths, with functional consequences for driving gene expression in the developing forelimb
statements.note: The abstract reports accelerations only along flightless paleognath lineages and does not examine flightless birds from any other group.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Within developmental pathways tied to repeated independent flight loss, convergent evolution was more prevalent in regulatory regions than in protein-coding genes.
statements.evidence: convergent evolution of regulatory regions, more so than protein-coding genes, is prevalent among developmental pathways associated with independent losses of flight
statements.note: Analysis of 11 new paleognath genomes showed that convergent evolution of regulatory regions, more so than of protein-coding genes, is prevalent in these pathways.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Among 284,001 conserved noncoding elements, a Bayesian analysis detected 2355 independent accelerations along the lineages of flightless paleognaths.
statements.evidence: A Bayesian analysis of 284,001 conserved noncoding elements, 60,665 of which are corroborated as enhancers by open chromatin states during development, identified 2355 independent accelerations along lineages of flightless paleognaths
statements.note: The Bayesian analysis of 284,001 conserved noncoding elements identified 2355 independent accelerations in flightless paleognath lineages.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The study found that shared regulatory changes make up a substantial part of the genomic landscape behind morphological convergence in ratites.
statements.evidence: Our results suggest that the genomic landscape associated with morphological convergence in ratites has a substantial shared regulatory component.
statements.note: The concluding sentence states that the genomic landscape of morphological convergence in ratites has a substantial shared regulatory component.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Each of the three hemipteroid orders, Psocodea, Thysanoptera and Hemiptera, was recovered as a strongly supported monophyletic group.
statements.evidence: Monophyly of each of the three hemipteroid orders (Psocodea, Thysanoptera, and Hemiptera) is strongly supported
statements.note: The abstract states that monophyly of each of the three hemipteroid orders is strongly supported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Trees built from the data matrices placed Psocodea as sister to holometabolous insects, a result that four-cluster likelihood mapping of the same data did not support.
statements.evidence: trees from our data matrices support Psocodea (bark lice and parasitic lice) as the sister group to the holometabolous insects (those with complete metamorphosis). In contrast, four-cluster likelihood mapping of these data does not support this result.
statements.note: Tree inference supported Psocodea as sister to holometabolous insects, whereas four-cluster likelihood mapping of the same data did not support this result.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Rearrangements of mitochondrial genome organization in hemipteroid insects are concentrated in the parasitic lice.
statements.evidence: We also explore implications for understanding the timing of diversification, the evolution of morphological traits, and the evolution of mitochondrial genome organization.
statements.note: The abstract only says implications for the evolution of mitochondrial genome organization are explored and reports no finding about where rearrangements occur.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Molecular dating with 23 fossil calibrations places the start of hemipteroid diversification earlier than the Carboniferous, more than 365 million years ago.
statements.evidence: A molecular dating analysis using 23 fossil calibration points suggests hemipteroid insects began diversifying before the Carboniferous, over 365 million years ago.
statements.note: Dating with 23 fossil calibration points indicates hemipteroid diversification began before the Carboniferous, over 365 million years ago.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: After the 501Y lineages emerged, their adaptive evolution involved repeated, positively selected convergent mutations at 35 genome sites, together called the 501Y meta-signature.
statements.evidence: Following their emergence, the adaptive evolution of 501Y lineage viruses has involved repeated selectively favored convergent mutations at 35 genome sites, mutations we refer to as the 501Y meta-signature.
statements.note: The abstract reports that 501Y lineage evolution involved repeated selectively favored convergent mutations at 35 genome sites, named the 501Y meta-signature.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Infections with the 501Y lineages B.1.1.7, B.1.351 and P.1 cause more severe disease than infections with earlier SARS-CoV-2 lineages.
statements.evidence: The independent emergence late in 2020 of the B.1.1.7, B.1.351, and P.1 lineages of SARS-CoV-2 prompted renewed concerns about the evolutionary capacity of this virus to overcome public health interventions and rising population immunity.
statements.note: The abstract mentions concerns about these lineages overcoming interventions and immunity but reports nothing about disease severity.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: A major global change in the selection pressures on various SARS-CoV-2 genes occurred at the same time as the B.1.1.7, B.1.351 and P.1 lineages appeared.
statements.evidence: the emergence of these three "501Y lineages" coincided with a major global shift in the selective forces acting on various SARS-CoV-2 genes
statements.note: Patterns of synonymous and non-synonymous mutations showed that the emergence of the three 501Y lineages coincided with a major global shift in selective forces.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Many other SARS-CoV-2 lineages are converging on the 501Y meta-signature, indicating it holds multiple mutation combinations able to promote lineage persistence under mounting host immune recognition.
statements.evidence: The ongoing convergence of viruses in many other lineages on this meta-signature suggests that it includes multiple mutation combinations capable of promoting the persistence of diverse SARS-CoV-2 lineages in the face of mounting host immune recognition.
statements.note: The ongoing convergence of many other lineages on the meta-signature is taken to show it includes mutation combinations capable of promoting persistence despite host immune recognition.
